osmTags.inscription: Der VEB Schichtpressstoffwerk Bernau (SPW) wurde am 1. Januar 1970 gegründet und war bis zu seiner Übernahme am 1. Februar 1991 mit ca. 1500 Beschäftigten der größte Betrieb im Ort. Das SPW war der einzige Hersteller von Elektroisolierstoffen in der DDR.

eras.label: Mapped site · auto T1
eras.summary: Location and terrain only. OpenStreetMap has no mapped outline for this site.
eras.basis: Everything drawn is traced from OpenStreetMap ways (ODbL) and the Terrarium elevation tiles. Each element names its OSM way.
eras.conjecture: Walls and buildings without a sourced height are drawn as kerb-high plan lines, never as masses. Closed walls have no gates: none are mapped. The DEM is ~30 m source resolution: it cannot show terraces, ditches or scarps. Nothing historic is depicted.

notes: site: osm:relation/7547995 historic=citywalls 257 m from ledger point
site is a site relation of 6 parts and none of them outlines the whole site, so no outline is drawn; the scene is fitted to the parts (506 x 478 m)
present-day buildings capped: kept the 120 nearest the outline centre of 543 mapped (trace size budget); the rest of the town is not drawn
roads capped: kept the 150 longest of 584 mapped (trace size budget); minor lanes are not drawn
origin moved 248 m from the ledger point to the centre of the mapped site
